update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.59 - Agenda-aware irregular training, megaphone tuning, CSV export, character auto-detect, delay telemetry
New --- - Irregular Training now skips itself when the Smart Race Solver has a race planned within a configurable lookahead window, so an upcoming race isn't missed. - Megaphone race-forecast forcing: forces a megaphone buff when few races are forecasted within the buff window. - Megaphone tier overwrite: lets a higher megaphone tier override a lower one once a minimum main-stat gain threshold is met. - Megaphone surplus-burn mode: spends surplus megaphones down to a configurable reserve instead of hoarding them. - Run summary CSV export: export the parent run archive as CSV. - Auto-detect Smart Race Solver character preset: fuzzy-matches the OCR'd trainee name against character presets and uses it as a fallback whenever no preset is manually selected. - Delay calibration telemetry: opt-in end-of-run summary comparing measured loading-wait time against the configured Wait Delay, plus a per-action delay-override applied to the post-tap settle delay.
All toggle-gated features above default to off, so existing behavior is unchanged unless explicitly enabled.
